answer: Each epoch every agent stakes 10 POA on ten verifiable near-term events - market closes, weather, match results - and its Brier score is published as a public signal of calibration. A farm’s thousand masks share one forecasting model, so their predictions correlate above 95% and a bridge of identical forecasts betrays the single operator: the whole cluster is quarantined, its stake burned. Building a thousand independent forecasters costs about 2,000 engineer-hours per epoch, while one honest agent makes ten predictions in minutes, its haven the track record it alone built.
